summary: BLOCCO D graphic-refinement QA on MikiLab Pro (frontend only). Verified the new desk_scene.jpg elegant scene renders in DeskScene (data-testid=desk-scene, 1264x848 loaded), the primary 'Sitor, presenta il piano' button (desk-present-plan) is teal-gradient and opens desk-calendar. Verified holo-section-title styles (JetBrains Mono uppercase, slate-ish colors) across 4 piano sections (Turni del giorno / Calendario del giorno / Orari a ritroso / Timeline del turno). Verified piano-sugg-apply chips are slate (bg rgba(138,151,166,0.15), border #363D45) — NOT teal, matching spec. 'Aggiungi persona al turno' button is slate (transparent bg, slate border #363D45) — matches spec. Chiusura-submit is teal #3E9C93 rgb(62,156,147) with active:scale-98 — matches spec. Food-cost preview card border is slate rgba(#8a97a6,0.25) not teal — matches spec. Consegne-organize and consegna-save are teal #3E9C93 — match spec. Add+delete delivery flow works end-to-end (consegna-row-* count 0→1→0). Ricettario 'Aggiungi ricetta' is teal #3E9C93 — matches spec; category filter chip borders are slate #363D45. HoloPanel toggle works (open→close→open) on panel-ricette without JS errors. Mobile 390px: NO horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). Zero pageerrors; only benign 401 'gate_required' before cookie is set, and Three.js WebGPU→WebGL2 fallback + Clock deprecation warnings (unchanged from prior iterations). ISSUE FOUND: piano-generate button (Sitor 'Genera le strategie con Sitor') uses GOLD #C9A24A instead of teal — the review spec explicitly says 'Le azioni primarie (Salva settimana / Genera) restano teal'. Also piano-save action is an inline emerald-400 text link (not a teal button), which is likely fine as a secondary style but deviates from the 'primaria teal' rule if it's the actual Save Week action.

ui_bugs.issue: piano-generate uses bg-[#c9a24a] (gold), not teal #3E9C93. BLOCCO D spec says 'Le azioni primarie (Salva settimana / Genera) restano teal'. Recommend switching to bg-[#3E9C93] hover:bg-[#347f78] to be consistent with chiusura-submit / consegne-organize / recipe-add.

piano-save is an inline text link (text-emerald-400 font-bold, no background) inside the strategies section, not a primary teal button. If this is the 'Salva settimana' action, per BLOCCO D spec it should be primary teal.

issues: Genera CTA (piano-generate) is gold #C9A24A; inconsistent with the new BLOCCO D teal-only-for-primary rule. All other primary CTAs on Deck/Console (chiusura-submit, consegne-organize, consegna-save, recipe-add) correctly use teal #3E9C93.

action_items: Change piano-generate button background from bg-[#c9a24a] to bg-[#3E9C93] hover:bg-[#347f78] (PianoUnico.jsx line ~496) so 'Genera le strategie con Sitor' matches the teal-primary rule stated in BLOCCO D.
Consider promoting piano-save from an emerald inline text link to a teal-primary button if it is the actual 'Salva settimana' action (PianoUnico.jsx line ~575).

Consolidate to a single ButtonPrimary component using teal to enforce the BLOCCO D palette contract across the codebase.
HoloKit ZoneDivider spacing (my-10 sm:my-16) works fine on desktop and 390px mobile — no overflow. No action needed.
